root_cause: CI latency and queue pressure were amplified by duplicate GitHub Actions entrypoints, broad main-push triggers and concurrency identities that did not consistently collapse obsolete work.
evidence: The repository contains many independent workflows while Required test is the protected PR authority.
Historical recovery PRs #3086 and #3091 independently reduced PR and main-push fan-out but were stale against current main.
Current Required test already aggregates selected lanes without sibling-workflow polling.
prevention: Keep Required test as the single protected PR authority.
Do not attach duplicate heavy website/portal verification entrypoints to pull_request when the canonical lane already covers them.
Path-scope main-push work to affected domains.
Use stable PR/ref concurrency identities with cancel-in-progress for obsolete validation work.
Reconcile stale recovery work onto current main rather than merging stale branches.
